codex_integration.mechanism: Native terminal-title thread identity and metadata-only runtime directory query through the TUI process's connected Unix socket
codex_integration.configuration_scope: User authorized native title setup; only tui.terminal_title was changed, with private backup and structured preservation checks
codex_integration.sqlite_location: No new shared-daemon SQLite lookup; the daemon supplies its live cwd
codex_integration.embedded_clients: Known title requires a matching writable rollout; fresh exact-identity state accepts canonical symlink aliases; no launch-C fallback in this branch

preservation.feature_baseline: Complete public 0.0.14 Mac source, retaining 0.0.11 custom behavior and selected 0.0.12/0.0.13 changes

limits: Codex native title configuration must emit the session-id/app-name prefix; this user's setting is enabled, and existing clients must be launched again to read it.
Shared-daemon metadata queries require daemon 0.162 or later; older daemon compatibility is not accepted.
Unknown, missing, stale or ambiguous session context skips relative references.
Codex terminal-title customization during the running invocation can remove the identity signal.
Existing scanner bounds and operating-system compatibility limits from public 0.0.14 still apply.

build.release_profile: normal optimized omw_local; no QA profile overrides
